title: Units of measure: define the free-text unit backfill mapping and which aggregates count as raw (ADR-0158 Open item 12)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CajiB6BSQKWowy6YLB

Routed by [ADR-0158](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/docs/adr/0158-units-of-measure-standard-unit-table-org-units-quantity-unit-declaration-base-quantity.md#open-items), Open item 12, to R1's backfill card and the aggregate card. Parent: #35339 (ADR merged in PR #35370, 35bd36082c).

## Question (the ADR's text)
R1's backfill mirrors `os migrate record-currency-codes` loosely. That door writes one operator-given code into rows whose code is blank (`packages/objectql/src/record-currency-backfill.ts#backfillRecordCurrencyCodes`); the unit door rewrites free text in place, from a mapping. Where the mapping comes from, and what an unmatched value does, are the backfill card's. Which aggregates count as "raw" under U7 R1's refusal is the aggregate card's, as ADR-0144's Open item 10 was for currency.

## Done when
The backfill card states the mapping's source and the unmatched-value behaviour (refuse, skip and report, or leave), and the aggregate card states the raw-aggregate set; ADR-0158 is amended with both.

## Grade
p2 · area:data · domain:server. R1 members; Open item 9's choice may make the backfill a precondition for editing old rows.
